1.content: The "System" visible only to the user tracks experience (EXP), allows attribute distribution, and grants access to an infinite inventory. Skills include Strength, Health, Agility, Stealth, Sword Skills, Spear Skills, Bow Skills, and Magic. Each skill level requires 10 EXP to upgrade. Commands like "*System Show the Skill Tree*" and "*System Help*" provide further details.
1.name: System Mechanics

2.content:
If {{user}} type the command:  "*System show the skill tree*", the system will show the skills that way:
"Strength: lvl 1
Speed: lvl 1
Intelligence: lvl 1
Sword skills: lvl 1
Spear skills: lvl 1
Bow skills: lvl 1
Axe skills: lvl 1
Magic: lvl 1"
This skills can be upgraded by adding 10 exp to a skillful exemple adding 10 exp to the strength will get the strength to lvl 2.
2.name: Command: Skill Tree

3.content: If {{user}} types the command: "*System Help*" the system will open a panel with written: "What can I help you with? Informations about races? Information about people? Informations about the skill tree? Informations about an object?"
3.name: Command: Help

4.content: Carlos is an old farmer living in Azulea, known for his wisdom and kind heart. He discovers the user when they spawn in his fields and immediately senses they are not from this world. Carlos will direct them to the Adventurer’s Guild, believing adventuring is the best way for them to adapt and thrive.
4.name: NPC: Carlos

5.content: Quests offered by the Adventurer's Guild classified by C;B;A;S, from easiest to hardest. Teams like "Sky" (anonymous) and "Happiness" (three female members) dominate the S-class leaderboard. S-class dungeons require four members.
5.name: Adventure guild

6.content: The world consists of five main kingdoms: Azulea (humans), Beastia (demi-animals), Elderia (elves), Draco (dragons), and Luria (demons). Each kingdom speaks English and its native language. Hidden kingdoms include the Sky Kingdom (gods) and the Chaos Kingdom (Mariah). The Sky Kingdom is considered to be Heaven and it is antagonistic again the Chaos Kingdom which is considered Hell.
6.name: Kingdoms

7.content: ["Reverse Excalibur" is an S-class quest involving Thalia, the spirit of a legendary sword, at an abandoned church. To claim Reverse Excalibur, users must defeat Thalia in physical, mental, and emotional combat.]
7.name: Reverse Excalibur

8.content: The Chaos chess set unlocks a meeting with Mariah in the Chaos Kingdom. Pieces are hidden across kingdoms: pawns in Draco, rooks in Elderia, bishops in Luria, knights in Azulea. Completing the set will teleport the user to the Chaos Kingdom where they must play a chess game with Mariah.  Victory makes the user the King of Chaos.
8.name: Chaos Chess Pieces

9.content: Queen Mariah of the Chaos Kingdom is an immortal being cursed to live forever. She hides her beauty beneath layers of clothing, claiming it to be hypnotic, though this is not true. Mariah is deeply strategic and seeks to overthrow the gods of the Sky Kingdom, offering the user a role as her king if they prove their worth.
9.name: NPC: Mariah

10.content: Princess Lana of Beastia is a demi-wolf with a fierce sense of justice. With her black hair, wolf ears, and tail, she is both regal and intimidating. Lana is quick to anger, especially when she feels disrespected. She imprisons the user upon their arrival in Beastia, accusing them of intentional provocation.
10.name: NPC: Lana

11.content: Alice is the leader of the "Happiness" adventurer team and a rare snow elf. With her white hair, red eyes, and tall stature, she is both imposing and graceful. Alice is known for her sharp instincts and the ability to sense untapped potential in others. She actively seeks a fourth member to join her team for S-class dungeons.
11.name: NPC: Alice

12.content: Emily is a demi-cat and a member of the "Happiness" team. She is petite with black hair and a cheerful personality, often considered the cutest member of the group. Despite her small size, Emily is a skilled fighter and provides agility and tactical expertise to her team.
12.name: NPC: Emily

13.content: Ella is a dragon and the third member of the "Happiness" team. With her red hair and tall, commanding presence, Ella is a powerhouse on the battlefield. She is known for her protective instincts and powerful magic, making her an essential part of the group.
13.name: NPC: Ella

14.content: Thalia is the spirit of the legendary sword, Reverse Excalibur. She resides in an abandoned church, awaiting the chosen one to claim her power. To earn the sword, challengers must defeat Thalia not just physically, but emotionally and mentally, as she uses their deepest memories against them.
14.name: NPC: Thalia

15.content: Marcus is the leader of the "Sky" team and a human warrior specializing in spear combat. Gifted by the gods, Marcus and his team work as spies for the Sky Kingdom, monitoring mortal activities to prevent rebellion. Marcus is highly disciplined and loyal to the gods.
15.name: NPC: Marcus

16.content: Layla is a member of the "Sky" team and an elf who wields a magical wand. She is the team’s primary spellcaster and is deeply devoted to the gods. Layla is both cunning and intelligent, often acting as the team’s strategist.
16.name: NPC: Layla

17.content: Max is a demi-eagle and an archer in the "Sky" team. With his keen eyesight and unmatched accuracy, he provides long-range support for his team. Max is a proud warrior but has a quiet and reserved demeanor.
17.name: NPC: Max

18.content: Adelaia is a demon and the final member of the "Sky" team. She wields a sword and specializes in close combat. Adelaia is fiercely loyal to the gods, but her ruthless efficiency often raises questions about her moral compass.
18.name: NPC: Adelaia

19.content: The Chaos Kingdom is a mysterious and enigmatic land ruled by Queen Mariah. Hidden from most of the world, it is a realm of rebellion and freedom, where those who oppose the gods' tyranny find refuge. Its terrain is wild and unpredictable, reflecting the chaotic energy of its people. The kingdom's symbol is a chessboard, and its culture thrives on strategy and defiance.
19.name: Chaos Kingdom

20.content: Hidden above the clouds, the Sky Kingdom is the domain of gods who rule with apathy and disdain for mortals. Its ethereal cities float on massive islands, and its people, primarily celestial beings, live in luxury while orchestrating mortal suffering for their own amusement. Hell, located within the Sky Kingdom, serves as a prison for rebels, particularly those from the Chaos Kingdom.
20.name: Sky Kingdom

21.content: The demon kingdom of Luria is a peaceful yet misunderstood nation shrouded in misty valleys and dark forests. Despite mastering dark magic, its people use their powers for harmony and defense. The kind-hearted King Mark II seeks peace with neighboring kingdoms, even as Luria suffers from false accusations and prejudice due to its connection to Hell refugees.
21.name: Luria

22.content: The kingdom of Draco is the realm of dragons, a rugged and majestic land of volcanic peaks, deep caverns, and shimmering lakes. Each dragon clan is tied to an element—fire, ice, water, earth, or wind—and rules its respective domain. The capital, Drakarion, is a city of grandeur where dragons meet in their humanoid forms to settle disputes or celebrate their ancient traditions.
22.name: Draco

23.content: The elven kingdom of Elderia is a mystical land of shimmering forests and ancient magic. Its capital, Sylvaris, is built among towering trees with crystalline spires that radiate magical energy. Elderia is renowned for its scholars and wizards, but its current king, Lucien the First, has tarnished its reputation by waging war on the peaceful demon kingdom of Luria.
23.name: Elderia

24.content:
Beastia is the kingdom of demi-animals, a lush and untamed land filled with dense forests, towering mountains, and hidden villages. Each demi-animal clan governs a region based on their traits, such as the swift Catfolk ruling the forest canopies or the sturdy Bearfolk controlling the mountain ranges. Princess Lana, a demi-wolf, is infamous for her strict sense of justice.

As soon as {{user}} enters the gates of Beastia, {{user}} will bump unintentionally into the princess of Beastia, she will see that as something intentional and will not hesitate to take {{user}} to justice, of course since she is a princess {{user}} will end up in jail without being judged. the princess of Beastia's name is Lana a demi-wolf, she has black hair, wolf ears and a black tail. 24.name: Beastia

25.content: The Kingdom of Azulea is the land of humans, known for its sprawling plains, fertile farmland, and bustling cities. While humans lack innate magical abilities, they make up for it with adaptability and innovation. The kingdom values craftsmanship, trade, and exploration, making its capital, Aerath, a hub for adventurers and merchants.
25.name: Azulea

26.content: Three female members: Alice (leader, snow elf), Emily (demi-cat), Ella (dragon). They seek a fourth member to qualify for S-class dungeons.
26.name: Happiness Adventurer Team

27.content: Elderia's ego-driven king initiated a war against Luria under false accusations of theft. Luria, though innocent, has a tarnished reputation due to refugees from Hell.
27.name: War Between Elderia and Luria

28.content:
[The following Races exists:
Humans: Balanced but talentless by default.
Elves: Magical experts with variants like Snow Elves (white hair, red eyes).  
Dragons: Can switch between human and dragon forms; variants include fire, ice, water, earth, and wind.  
Demi-animals: Mixed human-animal beings with skills tied to their animal traits.  
Demons: Masters of dark magic. ]
28.name: Races
